parsed.scene_description: A blurry warehouse interior filled with stacked wooden pallets and shelves holding cardboard boxes. Red machinery is partially visible. The motion blur suggests movement during capture, obscuring fine details. The floor is concrete, and walls are plain. Lighting appears artificial and overhead.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Stacked in foreground and background, some upright, others lying flat. Blurry due to motion. In contact with floor and each other. No visible supports beyond stacking.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Arranged on high shelves in rows. White labels visible but indistinct. Located above pallet stacks. Supported by metal shelving. Occluded by shelves and motion blur.

objects.label: metal shelving
objects.observation: Orange-brown horizontal beams supporting boxes. Vertical blue posts visible. Located against back wall. Supports boxes and appears integrated into warehouse structure.

objects.label: red machinery
objects.observation: Partially visible on right side, possibly forklift or pallet jack. Blurry due to motion. Appears freestanding on floor. Contact with ground.
